Game Overview

In Funny Rescue Zookeeper, the core idea is straightforward: step into the exciting world of zookeeping with Amia as you quickly tend to injuries and get her back to caring for delightful animals. Enjoy a charming experience with vibrant visuals and an engaging storyline that encourages empathy and responsibility, perfect for players of all ages.
